name: wm-tabbar-floating-dock
description: A dark, fully rounded pill tab bar that floats above page content with margin on every side. Five evenly spaced tabs each show an icon and a label; the active tab's icon sits inside a rounded highlight bubble and its label switches to the design's accent color.

props.name: activeAccentColor
props.description: Color applied to the active tab's icon and label to distinguish it from inactive tabs.

props.name: activeBubbleColor
props.description: Background color of the rounded highlight bubble behind the active tab's icon.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Index of the selected tab.

props.name: classname
props.description: Extra class names merged into the root style resolution.

props.name: dataset
props.description: Items to render as tabs. Overrides numberOfItems when supplied.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every tab.

props.name: getIcon
props.description: Render override returning a tab’s icon node.

props.name: getLabel
props.description: Render override returning a tab’s label.

props.name: iconPalette
props.description: Active and inactive icon colours.

props.name: itembadge
props.description: Dataset field, or expression, giving each tab its badge value.

props.name: itemicon
props.description: Dataset field, or expression, giving each tab its icon class.

props.name: itemlabel
props.description: Dataset field, or expression, giving each tab its label.

props.name: itemlink
props.description: Dataset field, or expression, giving each tab its navigation target.

props.name: maxvisibleitems
props.description: Tabs shown before the rest collapse into the overflow menu.

props.name: morebuttoniconclass
props.description: Icon class for the overflow button.

props.name: morebuttonlabel
props.description: Label under the overflow button.

props.name: name
props.description: Widget name, unique within the page.

props.name: numberOfItems
props.description: Tab count when no dataset is bound.

props.name: show
props.description: Whether the tab bar renders at all.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Show tab labels. This design draws them: all.

props.name: styles
props.description: Per-region style overrides, keyed by the design’s style regions.

events.name: onItemSelect
events.description: The active tab changed, however it changed.

events.name: onMoreItemClick
events.description: An item inside the overflow menu was tapped.

styles.name: root
styles.description: The floating shell that wraps the whole bar, including its outer margin.

styles.name: menu
styles.description: The rounded bar surface behind all tabs.

styles.name: activeTabItem
styles.description: The rounded highlight bubble behind the active tab's icon.
